scenario.description: Where code intelligence's places go and what they read (PLAN §18.1, §18.2, DESIGN §4.1): old-side references read the old side's text (the server's) and a row goes to that side; 700 references show their count as soon as the server answers, the review's file first; a hover card at the window's bottom hangs above its token, inside the main area; go to definition outside the repository opens a read-only file view of it, where hover works; Esc in the code keeps a composer's draft, which only Esc in the composer discards; screenshots of each.
